title: 🐉 Motion Trail

accepted_baseline.label: Full-stamp old-redraw
preserve: BASE remains available as variant 1 and must not be visually rewritten
color image rather than black line art

current_candidate.summary: Reusable Trail engine candidate with visible architecture notes and pseudo-3D trajectory modes (2D, CERCA, LEJOS, ÓRBITA, LOOP). The same repo-local sprite/stamp renderer carries z depth and perspective without WebGL; final patch also makes 3D trajectory velocity available to smooth orientation and avoids reseeding 2D stamps on resize while in 3D.

accepted_asset_direction: 2 WINGS is the current favorite and primary visual reference
real color imagery rather than black line art on white
creepy masks, faces, creatures, strange objects and winged/open forms
strong eyes, horns, ritual/iconic presence are desirable when the silhouette remains readable
open_feedback: Review the new CERCA / LEJOS / ÓRBITA / LOOP pseudo-3D modes visually, especially whether depth feels spatial rather than merely like scaling.
Some current masks still need cleaner segmentation: remove gray base/residue/halo before promoting them as final assets.
Generalize asset preparation into a reliable compileTrailAsset(image) pipeline so supplied images can enter Trail without per-image animation code.
Future candidate search may expand to ~20 clean color creepy/mask/creature/object cutouts, but only after the crop-quality gate is reliable.
Verify adaptive performance and all controls on the target phone.
resolved_feedback_in_current_candidate: 2 WINGS remains available and is now the default displayed variant.
1 BASE remains available with its accepted full-stamp rendering preserved.
Removed MANTIS/DRAGON/MOTH/OCTO/SKEL line-art direction from the promoted comparison set.
Added four color creepy Japanese mask candidates with strong faces/horns/eyes.
All six production assets live under visuals/trail-lab/assets and runtime performs no external image fetch.
BASE and WINGS were localized using build-time processing that reproduces their previous runtime treatment.
Mask backgrounds were segmented to alpha before promotion; production runtime does not draw museum/background rectangles.
No abrupt horizontal mirror/flip was reintroduced; current six variants use fixed orientation.
Adaptive quality, bounded stamp pool, low internal resolution, high-cadence full stamps and rebound accumulation were preserved.
Portrait mobile exposes all six numbered variants in a visible 3x2 grid.
Added visible in-page NOTES documenting the reusable Trail architecture and current iteration lessons.
Added pseudo-3D modes without changing asset-specific code: CERCA, LEJOS, ÓRBITA and LOOP add z depth to the same stamp records.
Kept 2D as the accepted full-stamp bounce mode.
Depth rendering uses projection and far-to-near ordering while preserving the bounded stamp pool.
No WebGL, mesh or per-image 3D implementation was introduced.

asset_localization_evidence.alpha_check: all six generated assets reported transparent corners [0,0,0,0]; mask assets reported 22.7%–36.3% near-transparent pixels; BASE/WINGS 48.4%/67.7%

mask_direction_review.note: User said the masks are much better and liked the mask direction, but some masks still show gray/base residue or insufficiently clean cut edges.

engine_architecture.projection: pseudo-3D focal projection; no WebGL required
optimization: single loaded sprite reused for all copies
allocation-free insertion depth ordering for the bounded pool
